criteria.priority_notes: Weighted at 50% (highest priority). Scored 0-5. Aspects: R&I objectives and ambition beyond the state of the art; soundness of methodology (interdisciplinarity, gender dimension, open science); supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge; researcher's professional experience.

Weighted at 30%. Scored 0-5. Aspects: credibility of measures to enhance the researcher's career perspectives and employability; suitability/quality of dissemination, exploitation and communication measures; magnitude and importance of contribution to expected impacts.

criteria.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
criteria.priority_notes: Weighted at 20%. Scored 0-5. Aspects: quality/effectiveness of the work plan, risk assessment and effort assigned to work packages; quality and capacity of the host institutions and participating organisations, including hosting arrangements.

overall_threshold: 70/100 (weighted sum of the three criterion scores)
